en: Illustrated postcard showing an indoor scene with people in Swedish folk costumes dancing and socializing around a table in a rustic room. A Swedish caption appears on the front in cursive. The reverse reads "BREFKORT. Carte Postale." with a Swedish 5 öre stamp canceled in Malmö and a round red seal for the Red Cross in Malmö, 1906, and an address written to a woman.
